relevant_laws.quote: No driver shall enter an intersection or a marked crosswalk unless there is sufficient space on the other side of the intersection or crosswalk to accommodate the vehicle he is operating without obstructing the passage of other vehicles or pedestrians, notwithstanding any traffic-control signal indication to proceed.
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen motor-vehicle driver and marked-crosswalk/intersection travel cell; actual boundaries and available space require Native source review.
